pattern: に照らして（にてらして）
purpose: Assess something against an explicit standard or evidence.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
N + に照らして / に照らすと
We will assess the application against the regulations.
Judging from experience, this estimate is too optimistic.
We checked the testimony against the facts.
formation: N + に照らして / に照らすと
restrictions: Common standards include rules, experience, and facts.
mistake: It is a figurative comparison, not literal illumination.
